strongest_angle: Examine the BBC's emergency court filings in November 2026 seeking to overturn a judge's decision to take Donald Trump's $10 billion defamation lawsuit to trial over a Panorama documentary edit.

key_facts.fact: Donald Trump filed a defamation lawsuit against the BBC in December 2025 initially seeking at least $10 billion before it was later reduced to about $5 billion.
In November 2026, Federal Judge Jeffrey T. Kuntz denied the BBC's bid to throw out the case and allowed the defamation claim to proceed.
The BBC lodged an urgent appeal with the US Court of Appeals for the 11th Circuit on November 25, 2026.
The defamation lawsuit stems from an episode of Panorama that edited a speech Donald Trump gave in January 2021 before the US Capitol riot.

named_entities.name: US Court of Appeals for the 11th Circuit
